question: Why is knowledge of the great ṣoḍhā not easily attained through minor effort?
premises: Knowledge of the great ṣoḍhā is the subject.
It is not the fruit of small austerity.
Great effort is implied as necessary.
inference: Knowledge of the great ṣoḍhā requires more than minor austerity.
uncertainties: The specific technical meaning of mahāṣoḍhā in this Śrīvidyā context is not fully specified here.
plain_english: Knowledge of the great ṣoḍhā is not the fruit of small austerity.
